openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: High Power 802.11n Mini Router including hardware watchdog, passive 12-18v (NON 802.3af) POE support, dual Ethernet Ports
openwrt_wiki.Flash Layout (v1): mtd0 u-boot 0x40000; mtd1 u-boot-env 0x40000; mtd2 custom 0x140000; mtd3 kernel 0x100000; mtd4 rootfs 0x600000; mtd5 rootfs_data 0x3c0000; mtd6 inactive 0x700000; mtd7 ART 0x40000
openwrt_wiki.OEM installation: ap51-flash eth0 <factory.bin>, dann OM2P an eth0 anschliessen und einschalten
openwrt_wiki.Basic configuration: Plug a lan cable to the left connector, telnet 192.168.1.1
openwrt_wiki.Interfaces: lan = eth0, wan = eth1 (passt nicht zur Gehaeusebeschriftung) - bezieht sich auf alte ar71xx-Firmware/v1
openwrt_wiki.Failsafe mode: Pushing the button for factory reset does not switch the device to failsafe mode.
openwrt_wiki.Buttons: There is only one tiny button for factory reset, but it doesn't seem to be supported by OpenWrt.
openwrt_wiki.Hardware Info (v1): CPU MIPS 24Kc V7.4; Memory 61272k/65536k; eth0/eth1 Atheros AG71xx; AR7240/AR9330 built-in switch; phy0 Atheros AR9285 Rev:2; m25p80 s25sl12800 (16384 Kbytes); ttyS0 16550A
openwrt_wiki.Photos: Model Number: OM2P 802.11g/n 150mbps Access Point with External Antenna (Fotos v1)
openwrt_wiki.Opening the case: 1. vordere 2 Gummifuesse (weit weg von den Anschluessen) abziehen; 2. 2 Schrauben loesen; 3. Deckel vorn hoechstens ca. 5 mm anheben und nach vorn schieben
openwrt_wiki.Serial: 3.3v serial port; 115200, flowcontrol none, parity none, 8 data bits; Ethernet-Buchsen vorn: von oben RXD, TXD, GND, VCC neben Antennenanschluss (v1)
openwrt_wiki.Notes: OM2Pv2: nach sysupgrade 19.07 -> 21 ohne Konfiguration wan/lan vertauscht; OM2P V2 ueber die Ethernet-Buchse nahe der Stromversorgung flashen, danach die andere fuer die Web-GUI; "This may also apply to other variants."

openwrt_git_ath79.Titel: ath79: Add support for OpenMesh OM2P v4
openwrt_git_ath79.Flash: 16 MB of SPI NOR flash - 2x 7 MB available; but one of the 7 MB regions is the recovery image
openwrt_git_ath79.Seriell: TTL pins are on board (arrow points to VCC, then follows: GND, TX, RX)
openwrt_git_ath79.eth1: Label: Ethernet 2; 802.3af POE; builtin switch port 1
openwrt_git_ath79.Flashing ap51-flash: The tool ap51-flash (https://github.com/ap51-flash/ap51-flash) should be used to transfer the image to the u-boot when the device boots up.
openwrt_git_ath79.Flashing initramfs: serielle Konsole -> u-boot: setenv serverip 192.168.1.21; setenv ipaddr 192.168.1.1; tftpboot 0c00000 <initramfs-kernel>.bin && bootm $fileaddr; dann sysupgrade -n
